selection: Lowest three-seed mean final-epoch validation MSE; best observed epoch is diagnostic only
preprocessing: Mean imputation and StandardScaler fitted on training split only
scheduler_step: Once after epoch training and validation; plateau receives that epoch validation MSE
history_lr: Learning rate actually used in that epoch before scheduler.step()
shared_control: lr-1e-03_constant histories/checkpoints copied from shared baseline controls; not retrained
fairness: Initial model SHA256 identical for every seed across all six cases; independent first-three-epoch checks exactly match shared controls
timing: Measured wall time under concurrent local experiments; indicative, not an isolated timing benchmark
